description: Review changed frontend behavior for state completeness and interaction consistency.

criteria.text: Loading, empty, error, success, disabled, and narrow-layout states are handled where applicable.
criteria.evidence: Cite the relevant component paths and deterministic or captured UI evidence for applicable states.

criteria.text: Primary actions, keyboard behavior, focus, and visible labels remain consistent with the surrounding product.
criteria.evidence: Cite the interaction implementation and its deterministic or captured UI evidence.
